barbarian.name: Barbarian
barbarian.desc: Builds Rage by smashing things, then spends it on crushing blows and leaps.

skills.desc: Smash a foe for 150% weapon damage with a 25% chance to stun. Generates 8 Rage on hit.
Sweep a wide arc for 120% weapon damage. Generates 6 Rage on hit, plus 2 per extra enemy.
Quick strike for 130% weapon damage. Each hit grants +10% attack speed for 4 s, up to 5 stacks. Generates 4 Rage on hit.
Bring down a massive hammer for 420% weapon damage in a wide arc. Costs 20 Rage.
Tear enemies around you for 100% weapon damage and make them bleed for 500% over 5 s. Costs 20 Rage.
Spin in a deadly storm, dealing 150% weapon damage to everything around you. You keep moving while you spin: hold the button and steer with the cursor or W A S D. Costs 10 Rage.
A crushing blow for 380% weapon damage to every enemy around you. Refunds 15 Rage per enemy hit. Costs 25 Rage. 6 s cooldown.
Leap up to 38 yards and crash down for 200% weapon damage, slowing enemies. Generates 15 Rage. 8 s cooldown.
Stomp the ground for 120% weapon damage and stun nearby enemies for 1.5 s. 10 s cooldown.
Grit your teeth: 50% damage reduction for 5 s. 20 s cooldown.
Shout: +40% Armor and +20% damage for 8 s. Generates 25 Rage. 20 s cooldown.
Shout: enemies within 22 yards deal 25% less damage for 6 s and are slowed for 3 s. Generates 10 Rage. 12 s cooldown.
Shout: heal 15% of your Life, then +30% Armor and 3% Life per second for 8 s. Generates 15 Rage. 20 s cooldown.
Call 2 ancestral spirits to fight beside you for 15 s. Each strikes for 120% weapon damage. 40 s cooldown.
Send a shockwave through the earth, dealing 220% weapon damage to everything in its path. Costs 30 Rage.
Charge up to 40 yards, dealing 250% weapon damage to enemies in your path. Generates 10 Rage. 8 s cooldown.

passives.desc: +5% Critical Hit Chance and +50% Critical Hit Damage.
Heal for 3% of all damage you deal.
Rage no longer decays out of combat and you gain 2 Rage per second.
Your shouts also grant +20% damage for 8 s.

paladin.name: Paladin
paladin.desc: A holy knight who charges in, bounces shields between foes and calls down heaven.

skills.desc: Strike for 140% weapon damage. Holy chains leap to 2 nearby enemies for 70%. Generates 6 Valor on hit, plus 3 per extra enemy struck.
Strike for 160% weapon damage and harden: +15% Armor for 5 s. Generates 5 Valor on hit.
Hurl a hammer of justice for 150% weapon damage. Generates 5 Valor.
Hurl a shield for 260% weapon damage that ricochets to 3 more enemies. Costs 18 Valor.
Call lightning from the heavens on an area for 340% weapon damage, with bolts leaping to nearby enemies. Costs 25 Valor.
Sweep your weapon in a huge arc for 300% weapon damage. Costs 20 Valor.
Charge up to 42 yards, dealing 200% weapon damage to enemies in your path. 6 s cooldown.
Bless the ground for 6 s: enemies inside take 100% weapon damage per second, you heal 3% Life per second. 14 s cooldown.
Your skin turns to iron: +100% Armor for 6 s. 18 s cooldown.
+25% attack speed and 20% damage reduction for 10 s. 25 s cooldown.
Call a pillar of holy light for 600% weapon damage, leaving burning ground. Costs 40 Valor.
Pass judgment on an area: 150% weapon damage and a 2 s stun. Costs 30 Valor. 10 s cooldown.
Slam your shield for 170% weapon damage with a 35% chance to stun for 1 s. Generates 7 Valor on hit.
Spinning hammers circle you for 160% weapon damage. You keep moving while they spin: hold and steer. Costs 12 Valor.
Holy light makes you invulnerable for 3 s. 30 s cooldown.
Shout: you and allies within 30 yards heal 20% Life and gain +25% damage for 8 s. 25 s cooldown.

passives.desc: When you would die, you instead survive with 30% Life. Once every 90 s.

demonhunter.name: Ranger
demonhunter.desc: Fast and fragile. Arrows, traps and vaults keep monsters at a distance.

skills.desc: Fire a seeking arrow for 125% weapon damage that pierces once. Generates 5 Focus.
Fire a chained arrow for 130% weapon damage that slows its target for 2 s. Generates 4 Focus.
Throw a bola for 80% weapon damage that explodes a moment later for 160% to nearby enemies. Generates 4 Focus.
Fire a fan of 7 arrows, each dealing 110% weapon damage. Costs 22 Focus.
Fire a burst of 2 arrows for 95% weapon damage each. Hold to keep firing. Costs 8 Focus.
Hurl a spinning blade that flies out and back, dealing 180% weapon damage each way. Costs 15 Focus.
Tumble up to 28 yards. You cannot be hit while vaulting. 3 s cooldown.
Vanish in smoke for 2.5 s: untargetable, invulnerable and 50% faster. 14 s cooldown.
Draw on shadow: heal 15% of damage dealt and move 20% faster for 5 s. 14 s cooldown.
Lay a trap that explodes for 380% weapon damage when an enemy comes near. Up to 3 active. 5 s cooldown.
Scatter caltrops at your feet for 6 s: enemies inside are slowed and take 40% weapon damage per second. 6 s cooldown.
Rain 18 volleys on an area over 2 s, each dealing 130% weapon damage. 12 s cooldown.
A dart for 90% weapon damage that poisons for 250% over 4 s. Generates 4 Focus.
Fire 2 arrows for 85% weapon damage each while you keep moving. Hold and steer. Costs 8 Focus.
Step through shadow to the cursor (up to 40 yards) and gain +50% damage for 3 s. 6 s cooldown.
Call a wolf companion for 25 s that bites for 110% weapon damage. 30 s cooldown.

passives.desc: +20% damage when no enemy is within 10 yards.
+20% damage to slowed or frozen enemies.

shaman.name: Shaman
shaman.desc: Commands lightning, earth and spirit wolves, with totems that fight beside you.

skills.desc: Hurl a bolt for 130% weapon damage. 30% chance to arc to a second enemy for 70%.
A shard of ice for 115% weapon damage that slows for 2 s.
Lob molten rock for 100% weapon damage that bursts for 90% to nearby enemies.
Lightning strikes the enemy nearest your cursor for 190% weapon damage, then jumps to 4 more. Costs 16 Mana.
Set the enemy nearest your cursor ablaze: 120% weapon damage, then 400% over 5 s. Costs 15 Mana.
Shake an area for 4 s: 160% weapon damage per second and a 50% slow. Costs 35 Mana.
Plant a totem for 12 s that shoots fire at nearby enemies for 90% weapon damage. 12 s cooldown.
Plant a totem for 10 s that slows all enemies nearby and shakes them for 40% weapon damage per second. 15 s cooldown.
Plant a totem for 10 s that heals you for 3% Life per second while you stand near it. 20 s cooldown.
Restore 4% of your Life per second for 6 s. 15 s cooldown.
Summon 2 spirit wolves for 20 s. Each bites for 80% weapon damage. 30 s cooldown.
Call a storm around you for 3 s: 12 bolts strike nearby enemies for 110% weapon damage each. Costs 30 Mana. 10 s cooldown.
A jolt of earth for 120% weapon damage with a 25% chance to stun for 1 s.
A river of lava for 95% weapon damage to everything in a line, leaving it burning. Hold to channel. Costs 14 Mana.
+60% Armor and immunity to slows and freezes for 6 s. 15 s cooldown.
Plant a totem for 10 s that hurls chain lightning at nearby enemies for 120% weapon damage. 18 s cooldown.

passives.desc: Regenerate 2% of your Life per second.
Gain 5 extra Mana per second and +30 maximum Mana.

skills.desc: Fire a seeking missile for 120% weapon damage.
Release 3 erratic charges for 70% weapon damage each.
Summon blades of arcane force to slash enemies in front of you for 165% weapon damage.

A ray of ice for 80% weapon damage that slows everything it touches. Hold to channel. Costs 16 Arcana.
Freeze all nearby enemies solid for 2 s and deal 100% weapon damage. 10 s cooldown.
Blink up to 42 yards, even through walls. 5 s cooldown.
Crystallize your skin: absorb damage equal to 40% of your Life for 6 s. 15 s cooldown.
Call a meteor for 700% weapon damage. It leaves the ground burning. Costs 45 Arcana.
A storm of ice for 5 s: 140% weapon damage per second and a 50% slow. Costs 35 Arcana.
Summon a fire hydra for 15 s that spits flame at enemies for 100% weapon damage. 15 s cooldown.
A bolt of ice for 110% weapon damage that slows for 2 s.
Spray 2 seeking missiles for 80% weapon damage each while you keep moving. Hold and steer. Costs 10 Arcana.
Bend time around you for 6 s: enemies inside are slowed and their projectiles crawl. 15 s cooldown.
Open a void that drags enemies in for 2 s, then collapses for 500% weapon damage. Costs 40 Arcana. 12 s cooldown.

passives.desc: +20 maximum Arcana and +3 regeneration per second.
+20% damage to slowed or frozen enemies.
Regenerate 2% of your Life per second.

priest.name: Priest
priest.desc: Shields, heals and holy fire. Hardest to kill, steady damage.

skills.desc: Fire holy light for 125% weapon damage. Each hit heals you for 0.5% of your Life.
A lance of light for 110% weapon damage that pierces through 2 enemies.
Assault the minds in front of you for 100% weapon damage and slow them.
Burst of light: 220% weapon damage around you and heal 8% of your Life. Costs 20 Faith.
Ignite an area for 250% weapon damage, then burn it for 4 s at 80% per second. Costs 30 Faith.
Throw a star that travels out and back, dealing 200% weapon damage each way. 6 s cooldown.
Shield yourself, absorbing damage equal to 35% of your Life for 8 s. 15 s cooldown.
Heal 3% of your Life per second and move 10% faster for 8 s. 12 s cooldown.
Become a cloud of spirit for 4 s: 75% damage reduction, untargetable, 30% faster. 25 s cooldown.
A word of power: 140% weapon damage around you and a 2 s stun. Costs 25 Faith.
Heal 15% of your Life and bless the ground for 5 s: 2% Life per second inside, 40% weapon damage per second to enemies. 15 s cooldown.
A spirit watches over you for 10 s: if you would die, you are instead healed to 50% Life. 60 s cooldown.
Judge an enemy for 115% weapon damage; it deals 20% less damage for 4 s.
A lance of light pierces everything in a line for 190% weapon damage. Costs 18 Faith.
Consecrate the ground for 6 s: you and allies inside take 40% less damage and heal 2% Life per second. 20 s cooldown.
Fly up to 40 yards, healing 10% Life and dealing 150% weapon damage to enemies you pass through. 10 s cooldown.

passives.desc: Regenerate 2.5% of your Life per second.
Melee attackers take 150% of your weapon damage.
12% cooldown reduction and skills cost 10% less.
